name: Chains
overview: Scripture presents chains as both literal and symbolic elements with diverse uses and meanings. They were worn as ornaments by princes and on camels, symbolizing status and wealth, as seen in Pharaoh’s gift to Joseph and the Midianite kings’ possessions (Genesis 41:42; Judges 8:26). Chains also had sacred significance, being part of the high priest's breastplate and temple partitions, reflecting God's ordained order and holiness (Exodus 28:14; Exodus 39:15). Additionally, chains served to confine prisoners, while figuratively representing bondage and oppression that believers are called to break free from, as Psalm 2:3 urges breaking bands and casting away cords.
